cards.title: The JUBAP Framework
cards.editorial_question: What does UP open up before JUMP filters for action?

editorial_readings.label: JUBAP intervention practice
editorial_readings.reading: The practice uses perspective changes and focused interventions to activate capacity within organisations.

editorial_readings.label: JUBAP intervention sequence
editorial_readings.reading: Connect focus, changes in perspective, leverage points and propagation of capability.

editorial_readings.label: Human perspective change
editorial_readings.reading: Reframe an issue so people can perceive additional options.

editorial_readings.label: Mission activation
editorial_readings.reading: Establish a focused commitment, accountable roles and a practical route to intervention.

cards.title: Nestlé North America — Where JUBAP Was Named
cards.editorial_question: How can a local blockage become a plant-wide constraint?

editorial_readings.label: Nestlé North America and JUBAP origins
editorial_readings.reading: The field case records the line from a shift in perspective to coordinated transformation action.

editorial_readings.label: Resistance indicators
editorial_readings.reading: Operational signals help locate obstacles to a transformation.

editorial_readings.label: Release and causal inquiry
editorial_readings.reading: Locate a drag point and investigate what sustains it before intervening.

editorial_readings.label: Internal capability after exit
editorial_readings.reading: The recipient can operate, resolve exceptions and learn after the interveners leave.

cards.title: Reframing Value Creation
cards.editorial_question: Which outcomes disappear when the portfolio frame narrows?

editorial_readings.label: Discovered value
editorial_readings.reading: Identify useful potential in existing capabilities.

editorial_readings.label: Frame revision
editorial_readings.reading: Reconsider objectives, categories and assumptions that define the option space.

editorial_readings.label: Genuine informational contribution
editorial_readings.reading: People produce situated information, knowledge or judgment.

editorial_readings.label: Capability migration and value capture
editorial_readings.reading: Capability creation, carriers, operation and value capture can occur in different places.

intra_cluster_edges.reading: The Nestlé account describes how the dashboard, liberation strategy and six-domain root-cause tool were used as a sequence.
intra_cluster_edges.boundary: La fuente pública es un relato del programa, no una evaluación causal independiente. No llamar Lean, Six Sigma o ensayo controlado a esta secuencia sin evidencia adicional.
